function.name: archive_documents
function.description: Archives a list of documents based on document IDs and an optional expiration date for archival. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

document_ids.description: A list of unique identifier strings for the documents to be archived.

expire_date.description: The expiration date for the archival in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-12-31'. If not provided, defaults to 'null' which implies no expiration.

notify_user.description: Flag indicating whether to notify the user upon successful archival. Defaults to false.

message.content:
Shashi Tej Reddy is an Indian politician and former army officer who has been active in the politics of the southern state of Telangana. He joined the Telangana Rashtra Samithi (TRS) and was elected to the Telangana Legislative Assembly from the Jangaon constituency. During his tenure he served as a cabinet minister in the state government, holding portfolios such as Food & Civil Supplies and later as Minister for Rural Development and Panchayats.

Before entering politics, Reddy had a long career in the Indian Army, retiring as a colonel after serving in various command and staff appointments. He has also been involved in business ventures and community development projects in his home region.

In recent years, Reddy has faced scrutiny over alleged financial irregularities and was suspended from the TRS in 2021 amid investigations into corruption charges.
